G2.0_expected_layout_use (info).note: fraction of each margin that a compact layout would use: sum of rate x expected need, the need the allocation shares in. v2: the library's representative cell of each device type, and from step 8 the routes over those cells (route_lengths; fraction_of_margin_route_as_sized_pcell keeps plan v2's route over the as-sized PCells). Above eta the budgets fall below the expected need

G2.7_library_floors_feasible.note: the cheapest cell of the S3 unit library for every element, all at once, as a fraction of eta*margin; > 1 means no layout built from library cells can meet the budgets at this eta

G2.8_baselines (info).note: outcome: every simulated check, the nominal ones and each rule's 5 most-used PVT points (one common set, as in plan v2); outcome_nominal: the nominal checks only

G2.10_model_agreement (info).flag_note: ASSUMPTION (plan v3 Phase A step 9): a difference above 0.25 of the margin, or a sign disagreement, lists the check for review; reported, not gated

G2.4_linear_all_budgets_at_once.note: reported: first-order sum vs exact linear model with every budget inserted
